items.note: Memory the profiler could not trace back to who asked for it

items.label: Plug-in wiring
items.note: The commands, menu entries and hooks each plug-in adds to the editor

items.label: Everything else
items.note: Screen buffers, settings, the widget tree behind the interface

items.note: Fifteen languages of interface text, all loaded whether you use them or not
